chapter_title: Chương 9: 0009 【Bạn tin vào tình yêu không?】

segments.title: Chương 9: 0009 【Bạn tin vào tình yêu không?】
segments.content:
While Chen Guiliang and Bian Guanyue were talking, a few boys started walking toward the back of the classroom.

But they were too embarrassed to reveal their true intentions, so they stopped at their friends' desks. While pretending to chat with their friends, they secretly stole glances at Bian Guanyue.

Xie Yang did the same, but he could get closer because he was good friends with Chen Guiliang.

"Sir Chen, changed seats, have you?"

Xie Yang, that bastard, was just trying to make conversation. He walked past Bian Guanyue without so much as a glance, acting as if he had no interest in her at all.

But when he was only a step away from her, Xie Yang suddenly raised a hand to flick his "gorgeous" hair, his body and head swaying rhythmically.

The hair falling over his forehead was precisely flicked to the side of his ear.

He thought this move was exceptionally dashing and cool, certain to attract the attention of the female students!

Unfortunately, from beginning to end, Bian Guanyue didn't spare him a single glance.

It was Chen Guiliang who was amused by his flamboyant display.

Under Xie Yang's utterly disappointed gaze, Bian Guanyue slung her schoolbag over her shoulder and walked out of the classroom.

Zheng Feng seized the opportunity to follow her. He too lacked the courage to get too close, always staying a few meters behind her. He fantasized about squeezing onto the same bus as Bian Guanyue, where countless coincidences could then occur.

For example, if the bus was packed with students, and the space inside was crowded and narrow, he would gallantly stand in front of Bian Guanyue, using his body to shield her from any harassment.

Zheng Feng followed her all the way out of the school gate and, sure enough, saw Bian Guanyue heading for the bus stop.

Then, he was dumbfounded.

Several taxis were parked by the roadside. Bian Guanyue pulled open a door, got into the back seat, and said, "Sir, to Houjie."

Watching the car drive away, Zheng Feng consoled himself: Taking a taxi is expensive. She can't possibly do it every day.

Only four or five students were left in the classroom.

Xie Yang lowered his voice and said excitedly, "Damn, getting a closer look just now, that Bian Guanyue is really beautiful. Sir Chen, don't you dare try to compete with me."

"Don't you like Zhou Jing?" Chen Guiliang asked.

Xie Yang made an excuse for himself, "Zhou Jing is too into studying. She's reading or doing problems all day long and has no time for romance. She's probably not right for me."

Chen Guiliang teased him, "You fucking only know how to have a crush. If you dared to say more than a few words to a girl you like, I'd respect you as a man. What, are you hoping Bian Guanyue or Zhou Jing will take the initiative and chase after you?"

"Piss off, what the hell do you know!"

Xie Yang was instantly angry and embarrassed, feeling as if his pants had been pulled down.

Don't I have a reputation to maintain?

In truth, back in his high school days, how was Chen Guiliang any different when it came to girls?

He was extremely proud and arrogant deep down.

But his upbringing and dire financial situation also gave him a deep sense of inferiority.

He couldn't even afford to take a girl out for a meal, so how could he possibly be in a relationship?

Therefore, Chen Guiliang never had a girlfriend throughout his entire time as a student. After graduating, he was busy making a living and had even less time and energy to think about matters of the heart.

It wasn't until he was past thirty, when his living conditions had improved and his salary was substantial, that he started going on blind dates to settle the matter of marriage.

The woman was quite satisfied with him. She only asked for a betrothal gift of 66,000 yuan but provided a dowry of a car worth over 200,000 yuan. They also bought their marital home with joint funds—a common practice in the Sichuan-Chongqing region.

Dammit, I was born in the wrong place. His wife was a teacher at a key elementary school, a local of Rongcheng. She was decent-looking and came from a well-off family.

Before marriage, she appeared well-read and reasonable, but after marriage, her character flaws were exposed. She would nag about every trivial matter and fuss over every insignificant issue. She also loved to compare her husband with the husbands of her best friends, colleagues, and relatives, always starting with, "Look at so-and-so's husband..."

Chen Guiliang felt less like a husband and more like a primary school student constantly being scolded by a teacher, and one who was always being compared to other people's children at that.

The family conflicts finally erupted completely when Chen Guiliang was fired by his boss.

Divorce.

The only silver lining was that housing prices in Rongcheng had skyrocketed in those two years, and he actually made a profit from selling their marital home.

After becoming single again, and later achieving financial freedom, Chen Guiliang had sought out young models. It was exciting at first, but after a few times, it became dull.

His parents urged him to remarry, so he gritted his teeth and went on a few more blind dates.

He was dissatisfied with all of them.

He had not only lost his passion for romance but also had no interest in settling for marriage.

As for his physical needs, they could be completely satisfied with money. A wave of his hand and young girls would flock to him. What was the point of talking about family and feelings?

"Chen Guiliang, Xie Yang, remember to turn off the lights when you leave!" Class President Li Rui shouted from the classroom doorway.

Xie Yang said impatiently, "Got it."

The classroom was empty, with only the two of them left.

Chen Guiliang said, "Let's go. Let's slip out and buy a pack of cigarettes before the school gate is locked."

Xie Yang gave his hair a dashing flick, no longer dwelling on the earlier matter, and walked side-by-side with Chen Guiliang, his hands in his pockets.

They quickly went to the store outside the school, and Chen Guiliang bought a pack of Hongtashan cigarettes.

Xie Yang had originally intended to buy the cheaper Hongmei, but seeing this, he gritted his teeth and bought Hongtashan as well. They were best buddies, after all; they had to be in sync.

When they returned to the school gate, the guard was just locking up.

Like the cafeteria ladies, the school gatekeeper was also one of Chen Guiliang's "enemies."

But at 40, Chen Guiliang wasn't one to hold a grudge against a gatekeeper. He handed him a Hongtashan and said, "Sir, could you please open the gate?"

The gatekeeper was almost flattered.

This troublemaking, crazy student was actually offering him a cigarette for the first time ever? And he was calling him "Sir"?

"Come on in." The gatekeeper took the cigarette, stuck it in his mouth, and pulled out his keys to unlock the iron gate.

Actually, it wouldn't have mattered if he didn't open it. Chen Guiliang would have just climbed the wall.

"Thanks."

Once inside, Chen Guiliang didn't head straight back to the dorm. Instead, he walked toward the man-made lake.

Xie Yang lit a cigarette for himself and then passed the lighter to his best friend.

Chen Guiliang found a stone bench by the man-made lake and sat down. He took a deep drag of his Hongtashan, staring blankly at the dark surface of the water.

This young body felt wrong!

During evening self-study today, when Bian Guanyue was sitting next to him, the faint scent of her shampoo and body wash wafted over, and Chen Guiliang felt a restless stirring, like an animal in heat.

Damn it, the raging hormones of puberty were making it hard to control his own thoughts.

"Xie Yang, do you believe in true love?" Chen Guiliang asked, blowing smoke rings.

Xie Yang's focus was peculiar. "Damn, how do you blow smoke rings? That's so fucking cool. Quick, teach me!"

Chen Guiliang said, "Call me Grandpa and I'll teach you."

"My dear grandson!"

Xie Yang flipped him the bird and tried to blow a smoke ring.

Chen Guiliang said, "What do you think if I tried to have a relationship during the rest of my time in high school?"

"Sir Chen wants to be in a relationship?" Xie Yang's curiosity was instantly piqued. "Which fair lady do you have your eye on? The prettiest in our class is Zhou Jing, and now there's Bian Guanyue. Ou Yafei from the class next door, Class 12, is also very pretty, but it's a pity we don't have many chances to talk to her."

Chen Guiliang looked at him with contempt. "You dumbass, all you know is to look at faces. The one in our class with the best figure is Zhu Xiaoya."

Xie Yang disagreed. "Zhu Xiaoya just has big boobs. She's not that pretty."

Chen Guiliang couldn't be bothered to argue with a virgin.

He suddenly realized what he should be doing.

It didn't matter whether he won an award in the New Concept Composition Competition.

Failing the college entrance exam was no big deal either.

Having been reborn, he should make up for his biggest regret.

What was his biggest regret?

Of course, it was having lived half his life without ever experiencing a pure love, untainted by money.

He really wanted to know what love tasted like.

So who should he pursue?

Chen Guiliang's high school crush was precisely that Ou Yafei from the class next door.

She had a pretty face, knew how to dress, and was like a little siren.

Back then, every time Chen Guiliang passed by Class 12, he would secretly peek into the classroom. Just to catch a glimpse of Ou Yafei, even if it was just her back, would make him content.

But the pedestal he had placed this "white moonlight" on had shattered long before his rebirth.

After achieving financial freedom, driven by some unknown impulse, he had deliberately contacted some alumni to ask about Ou Yafei in detail.

It would've been better if he hadn't asked!

In the accounts of those alumni, Ou Yafei's history was full of scandals.

It turned out that the goddess of Chen Guiliang's crush had secretly had an abortion during the summer vacation of their second year.

During college, to secure a spot in graduate school, Ou Yafei had seduced a professor and was slapped in public by the professor's wife.

After graduation, it seemed she was kept by someone, but the rumor was unconfirmed.

Later, she married a businessman. Some said she was a homewrecker who had succeeded, and her husband was more than 20 years her senior. She quit her job to be a full-time housewife, showing off luxury goods on her Moments every other day.

When Chen Guiliang found all this out, he felt as disgusted as if he had swallowed a fly.

Xie Yang flicked his ash, tossed his hair dashingly, and said with clueless confidence, "We're friends, so we can compete fairly to see who can win Bian Guanyue over first."

Chen Guiliang said, "Why don't we compete to see who can get into Tsinghua or Peking University?"

"Do you even know how to hold a conversation?" Xie Yang was not pleased.

Chen Guiliang thought Bian Guanyue wasn't bad.

But they hadn't had much contact in his past life, and they lost touch after high school graduation.

There were rumors that Bian Guanyue had gotten married and gone abroad.

There were also rumors that she had come out as gay, was living in Shanghai, and had adopted a child.

The two rumors were completely contradictory; he didn't know which was true.

Chen Guiliang stubbed out his cigarette, got up to throw it in the trash can, and sighed with emotion, "Alas, in this entire, vast No. 2 High, there isn't a single girl worth pursuing. Perhaps I'm just too outstanding, sword in hand, I gaze around, lost and bewildered!"

Xie Yang flicked his hair again and retorted, "You're still the fucking better poser."

Chen Guiliang strolled along the lakeside. Past the wisteria trellis ahead and through a grove of camphor trees was the dormitory.

Xie Yang followed silently, his mind still comparing Zhou Jing and Bian Guanyue. He discovered he was a man of deep affections; after all, he had had a crush on Zhou Jing for so long. Even though his affections were now shifting, he still couldn't let go of his "old flame."

As the two got closer to the wisteria, a rustling sound came from under the trellis.

They could even faintly hear panting.

It must be a pair of lovebirds having a secret rendezvous. They surely wouldn't dare to go all the way, but hugging, kissing, and a bit of groping would have to suffice.

Xie Yang lightened his steps and let out a low, mischievous chuckle, "Hehe, something's going on."

"You're going to peep? Be careful you don't get a sty," Chen Guiliang said.

Xie Yang said, "I'm just going to take a look."

"Ahem, ahem!"

In the pitch-dark, Chen Guiliang suddenly coughed twice, then barked in a gruff voice, "Which class are you from? Get back to your dorms!"

In the quiet night, the shout was like a clap of thunder.

The couple under the wisteria trellis thought a teacher had arrived and, terrified, immediately scattered and ran in opposite directions.

One fled toward the boys' dorm, the other toward the girls' dorm.

Each to their own when disaster strikes.

Chen Guiliang stood there, pleased, and said, "I don't even have a girlfriend yet. Anyone who dares to date in this school must die."

Xie Yang found it hilarious. He too started stomping his feet loudly on the spot, simulating the sound of pursuit, "Stop! Nobody move! Get caught dating and you'll be expelled!"

The lovebirds, terrified, picked up their pace again.

"Hahahaha!"

The two psychos laughed triumphantly by the lake.

They returned to their dorm in high spirits. As soon as they entered, they heard Li Yulin from Bed 5 say, "Damn, you guys are finally back. I was just on a date with Wang Yu by the man-made lake and almost got caught by a teacher. That was so fucking close. Good thing I run fast!"

It's not that I want my bro to suffer, it's just that I can't stand him getting a girlfriend before me. (Thanks to Tarot Club's Cleaner and toydemon for their Alliance Leader donations.)
